name: primitives-effects-theme-toggler
title: Theme Toggler
description: A small settings card with a segmented control for Light, Dark and System; picking one flips the whole page's theme with a gradual sweep instead of an instant snap.
use: A site offers light, dark and system themes and wants the switch to feel deliberate.
avoid: The wipe needs the browser's View Transitions API, so older browsers just snap with no sweep.
a11y: The chosen option is marked only by a data attribute, so screen readers are not told which theme is active, and there is no focus ring. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A dark rounded card titled Appearance with two lines of grey copy above a three-part control. Each third holds a small icon and a label; the active one gets a lighter background, white text and a soft shadow.
behaves: Clicking a segment marks it active and reveals the new theme across the page with a wipe that grows from one edge. Light and Dark resolve directly, while System follows the operating system setting.
customise: It renders whatever the children function returns and calls your setTheme, with theme, resolved theme and wipe direction as props; the wipe timing is fixed.
weight: light: One view transition and an empty style tag; no loop or canvas.
